== Missing-title variant ==
The collecting encyclopedia records a Japanese printing of E-web Blaster with a blank title strip.<ref name="missing-title-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

[[File:Japanese-Hoth-E-web-Blaster-Missing-Title-Encyclopedia32-p48.png|thumb|center|340px|Japanese E-web Blaster with a blank title strip.]]

Destiny 5, deploy 3, and forfeit 1. The title and the label strip below the photograph are blank.<ref name="missing-title-face" />

=== Japanese text on the variant ===
'''Lore''' — <span lang="ja">歩兵用兵器としては最大級のものであり、強力な光弾は宇宙戦闘機にすらダメージを与える。</span><ref name="missing-title-face" />

'''Game text''' — <span lang="ja">任意の位置に配備する。1フォース余分に支払うことにより、2名の戦士で移動させることができる。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が2フォース消費して起動できる。運命数を引く。目標がキャラクターかビークルなら、運命数＋1＞能力値／装甲値／回避値で命中する。目標が宇宙戦闘機なら運命数＞4で命中する。</span><ref name="missing-title-face" />

=== Translation of Japanese Text ===
'''Lore''' — One of the largest infantry weapons. Its powerful light bolts can damage even starfighters.

'''Game text''' — Deploy at any location. Two warriors can move it by paying 1 extra Force. One of your warriors at the same place can activate it by spending 2 Force. Draw destiny. A character or vehicle target is hit if destiny +1 exceeds ability, armor or maneuver. A starfighter target is hit if destiny exceeds 4.

The English face prints the title and the Artillery Weapon label. Its deployment text says “site,” where the Japanese variant says 位置 (location). The Japanese wording describes activating the weapon, where the English wording describes targeting with it.<ref name="missing-title-face" /><ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-ewebblaster-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[E-web Blaster]].</ref>
